name: Shoalfire
author: E. T. Carter
description: Looking down through shallow clear water onto rippled sand: crimson caustic filaments with pale hot cores fold, pinch and slide across the ripple crests and catch the flank of a weathered boulder, while silt drifts through faint shafts and the floor recedes into deep wine haze. The swell keeps the light lines stretching, merging and pinching off continuously.

params.label: Swell
params.effect: How fast the surface swell slides the caustic filaments across the sand.

params.label: Focus
params.effect: How sharply the waves pinch the light into bright filaments, from soft dapple to tight folded threads.

params.label: Shafts
params.effect: Strength of the slanting light shafts and the glow of the silt in them.
